# messq_quickstart

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq quickstart

run the five-minute tour on a throwaway daemon

### Synopsis

Run the guided tour: a throwaway daemon in a temp directory that you
publish to, ack from, nak with backoff, and deliberately let a message
time out into the DLQ — ending with the unprompted trace of the dead
message. The tour runs real commands, and prints exactly what it runs.

Nothing outside the tour's own directory is touched, and every MESSQ_*
variable from your environment is ignored: the tour never talks to your
real daemon. No config file, no --data-dir, no setup — that is the point.

```
messq quickstart [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq quickstart # noexec: the full tour needs the delivery commands (#13/#14)
  messq quickstart --output ndjson # noexec: one record per step, for machines; same dependency
  messq quickstart --keep # noexec: keeps a data dir; same dependency
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for quickstart
      --keep            keep the throwaway data dir and print the command that reopens it
      --no-banner       skip the banner (for asciinema recordings)
      --output string   output mode: text|ndjson — ndjson emits one record per step (default "text")
      --pause           wait for Enter between steps (default: only on a terminal)
```
